historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission unanimously found the transfer of the lot from the Real Estate Department to the Health Department, for a Potrero Hill neighbourhood health center north of Starr King school, in conformity with the Master Plan, provided Coral Way stayed open and a six-foot sidewalk was kept beside the schoolyard.
Ground was broken at the construction site of the Potrero Hill Health Center here.
The opening ceremony was announced for the Potrero Hill Health Center here, a satellite clinic of San Francisco General Hospital.
Renovations to the Potrero Hill Health Center here were completed, reworking admitting and patient-interview space for efficiency and privacy.
